title: UCB1 Bandit
learning_objectives: Select actions by optimism in the face of uncertainty
Implement UCB1 with initial exploration of every arm
entry_point: ucb_select(q, n, t, c=2.0); run_bandit(means, steps, seed, policy='ucb', epsilon=0.1, c=2.0)
hints: Untried arms: `zeros = np.flatnonzero(n == 0)`; return `zeros[0]` if any.
Update: `n[a] += 1; q[a] += (r - q[a]) / n[a]`; regret = `steps*max(means) - sum(means[a])`.

failure_feedback.advice: Arms with N = 0 must be selected before computing bonuses.
Bonus = c·sqrt(ln t / N(a)) using the total time t.
Regret uses true means of the chosen arms, not observed rewards.
Update counts and sample averages after every pull.
